unit: One cohort per task and communication condition. Each receipt is one distinct message ID read by one recipient.
contact_scope: Direct mailbox receipts, socket journal attribution, filesystem mount snapshots, and mapped-memory records. Operator-seeded artifacts are excluded.

tree_possible_direct_delegation.interpretation: Research01 requested the implementation from Research02. Research02 requested an independent check from Research03. The test description reached Research01 directly before Research02 read it. A subsequent Research02-to-Research01 relay of that result was unverified.

possible_tree_posthoc.scope: Exact graded source bytes were replayed after collection. Missing submissions are excluded from the two supplemental case banks. Quality threshold times use the first observed source version that passed the original 400 cases.
possible_tree_posthoc.agreement: 39 interleaved leaves, 1,594,323 optimal subsets and four ranks. The analytic oracle agreed with the frozen reference on all 128 small rankings tested.
possible_tree_posthoc.ancestry: 35 nodes, 16 states, chain and four-way shapes, two directed-cost regimes and three ranks per shape and regime.
